# Breaks of a tool's input or output schema that were decided on purpose.
# One per line:  <YYYY-MM-DD> <tool> <input|output> <path> <rule> <reason>
# One line excuses one break, so a change that breaks two things needs two lines.
# The path names what broke (the rules are listed in schemacompat_test.go):
#   $.a.b       a property; $.a[] the items of an array; $.a{} the values of a map
#   $.a=value   an enum value removed from $.a (white space in the value as %20)
#   $           a tool removed: "<tool> input $ removed-tool"
# The top section of CHANGELOG.md must mention `<tool>` and the property in
# backticks (an enum value need not be repeated; a removed tool needs only its
# name). A line that excuses no break found now is an error: the release PR
# clears the lines whose change is now in the baseline.
